character.lede: A layered blue-and-white modern house stacks a white-framed upper box over blue-grey concrete panels, with a glass-railed loggia. A slatted pergola patio opens off the living room, and a plunge pool sits on the roof terrace.

spots.line: A workbench and a bicycle share the garage and utility room.
A bunk bed, a writing desk and a laptop share the kids' room.
Two sofas, a loveseat and a barrel chair gather round a coffee table.

facts.style: Layered blue-and-white modern: a white-framed upper box with a recessed glass-railed loggia, a charcoal portal round the glazed stair, blue-grey concrete panels below, and a rear roof terrace with a plunge pool over the bedroom; a walnut-and-leather living room behind west glass onto a slatted pergola patio

character.truths: The Core sits on a credenza in the Living Room. There is no television. Kitchen and dining share one room with a breakfast bar. Pergola patio and a rooftop plunge pool.
